Embark on a fulfilling teaching career with Bihar Public Service Commission's (BPSC) latest recruitment drive. The BPSC School Teacher TRE 4.0 Recruitment 2026 invites applications for primary, middle, and secondary school teachers, as well as TGT and PGT positions. Candidates can apply online for vacancies in the Education Department and SC & ST Welfare Department, covering classes 1-12. Review the official notification for eligibility criteria, selection process, age limits, salary scales, and more to kickstart your teaching journey in Bihar's government schools.

Bihar Public Service Commission (BPSC) invites applications for School Teacher positions in primary, middle, and secondary levels. Eligible candidates can apply online for TGT, PGT, and special school teacher roles under the Education Department and SC & ST Welfare Department, Government of Bihar. Check the official notification for details on eligibility, selection process, age criteria, salary, and more. Apply within the scheduled dates to join the BPSC team and shape young minds in Bihar's education sector.
